snapshot.title: Make construction page clearer
snapshot.description:
When building a rocket, it should be made clearer what parts are there, maybe generate some icons/assets.

Or how about - build what I originally wrote - a sandbox environment/layout where the user drags parts or entire rockets onto a launchpad, and we see the rocket there.

When I ran this scene past testers the assembley section wasn't clear that that was the rocket, finished, ready to go - they tried clicking on the assembley section
